facts.text: Explora Atacama sits on a 42-acre (17-hectare) desert estate near San Pedro de Atacama.
facts.excerpt: Situated on a pristine 42-acre (17-hectare) desert estate near San Pedro de Atacama

facts.text: The lodge sits on the Ayllu de Larache, surrounded by the sand dunes and high-elevation parklands of San Pedro de Atacama.
facts.excerpt: Explora Atacama boasts a perchon the beautiful Ayllu de Larache, surrounded by the sand dunes and high-elevation parklands of enchanting San Pedro de Atacama, the Atacama’s most famous oasis.

facts.text: The lodge gives easy access to the Altiplanic Lagoons and the ancient Pukara de Quitor archeological site.
facts.excerpt: The lodge also affords easy access to the many wonders of the desert and the high-elevation Altiplano, including the nearby Altiplanic Lagoons and ancient Pukará de Quitor archeological site.

facts.text: The lodge was designed by Chilean architect Jose Cruz Ovalle.
facts.excerpt: Designed by famed Chilean architect José Cruz Ovalle

facts.text: Locally sourced furnishings, soaring spaces and sweeping views define the grounds and interiors.
facts.excerpt: Soaring spaces, sweeping views and locally sourced furnishings define the grounds and interiors

facts.text: The lodge has four interconnected pools surrounded by tall pampas grass and Atacama flora, each offering a different experience.
facts.excerpt: Surrounded by tall pampas grass and Atacama flora, our four interconnected pools are the perfect place to relax and soak in the quiet of the desert. Each pool offers a different experience

facts.text: One of the pools is warmed to 77-82 degrees Fahrenheit (25-28 degrees Celsius).
facts.excerpt: including a pool warmed to 77–82°F (25–28° C)

facts.text: The spa is in a traditional adobe house and offers treatments, a sauna, steam baths and outdoor hot tubs.
facts.excerpt: Nearbyin a traditional adobe house, visit our spa with a range of treatments as well as a sauna, steam baths and outdoor hot tubs.

facts.text: The lodge has its own onsite observatory with guided star tours.
facts.excerpt: Seethese dazzling night skies from our very own onsite Observatory, with guided star tours and Explorations that reveal the Milky Way, planets and endless constellations.

facts.text: Guests can ride out on horseback from Explora's own stables.
facts.excerpt: Then venture out on horseback from Explora’s own stables

facts.text: Guests can soak in natural hot springs in Explora's private Puritama Conservation Reserve.
facts.excerpt: soak in the natural hot springs, exclusively located in Explora’s PuritamaConservation Reserve

facts.text: The Puritama Conservation Reserve lies in an Andean canyon and is a river oasis and sanctuary for endangered wildlife.
facts.excerpt: Encompassing a unique ecoregion deep in an Andean canyon of the Atacama Desert, Explora’s private Puritama Conservation Reserve offers an important river oasis and sanctuary for endangered wildlife.

facts.text: The stay includes a choice of dozens of expertly guided Explorations.
facts.excerpt: Your stay at Explora Atacama includes your choice of dozens of expertly guided Explorations.

facts.text: Explorations are limited to groups of no more than eight guests.
facts.excerpt: Explorations are limited to a group size of no more than eight guests to allow for a more personal atmosphere and in-depth discovery.

facts.text: Each evening an Explora guide meets with guests to tailor the next day's Explorations.
facts.excerpt: something you’ll experience every evening, when your Explora guide meets with you to tailor the next day’s Explorations to your preferences.

facts.text: Guides are trained at Explora's own School of Guides and are fluent in Spanish and English.
facts.excerpt: They’re trained at our own School of Guides and fluent in Spanish and English.

facts.text: Explorations include hiking the Cordillera de la Sal with views to the Valley of the Moon.
facts.excerpt: These Atacama adventures and experiences include hiking the Cordillera de la Sal with views to the Valley of the Moon

facts.text: The stay includes breakfast, lunch and dinner, all beverages, wine and an open bar.
facts.excerpt: Your stay at Explora Atacama includes every dining experience during your stay, including breakfast, lunch and dinner, as well as all beverages, wine and an open bar.

facts.text: The daily menu highlights the flavors and culinary traditions of Chile's Atacama region.
facts.excerpt: we present an authentic, handcrafted daily menu that highlights the bold flavors and rich culinary traditions of Chile’s Atacama region

facts.text: The stay includes national park entrance fees and round-trip airport transfers.
facts.excerpt:
National Park Entrance Fees

facts.text: Reaching the lodge involves a 2-hour connecting flight from Santiago to Calama.
facts.excerpt: After arriving in Santiago, Chile’s capital city (SCL), you need to take a 2-hour connecting flight to the city of Calama.

facts.text: Wi-Fi access in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability due to the remote location.
facts.excerpt: Please note that due to our remote locations, Wi-Fi access in rooms and common areas may vary in reliability.

facts.text: In winter, temperatures at the lodge range from -10 C (14 F) at night to 20 C (68 F) in the daytime.
facts.excerpt: During winter, the temperatures in Explora’s Atacama Desert Lodge fluctuate between -10°C (14°F) at night and 20°C (68°F) in daytime.

facts.text: Explora recommends staying at least five nights.
facts.excerpt: we recommend staying for at least five nights

facts.text: Catur Suites have views of the countryside.

Views of the countryside.

facts.text: Explora Atacama reopened on December 21, 2016, after a full reconstruction following a fire.
facts.excerpt: The hotel located at San Pedro oasis in the heart of the Atacama Desert reopened December 21, 2016. The reopening follows the hotel’s full reconstruction from a fire that occurred late last year.

facts.text: The rebuilt hotel added a larger outdoor terrace with views of Licancabur volcano.
facts.excerpt: new offerings including a significantly larger outdoor terrace space with views of Licancabur volcano

facts.text: The hotel's horses have been bred specifically for the region.
